answer: Escrowed Interaction Reserve. Each identity must lock a vault deposit sized to its 30-day outbound message volume, escrowed 90 days before withdrawal. Sybils splitting traffic pay the reserve per pseudonym, so cost scales linearly with identity count rather than volume. The umber ledger records reserve age, and only aged reserves unlock comet-tier routing priority. Attackers pay full reserve on every fake identity while gaining negligible throughput.
